title: Identification of deubiquitinase inhibitors via high-throughput screening using a fluorogenic ubiquitin-rhodamine assay
protocol: Prepare assay buffer by mixing 50 mM Tris pH 8, 50 mM NaCl, 0.002% Tween-20, and 5 mM DTT.
Prepare a 2x DUB solution in assay buffer to make 170 mL.
Prepare a 2x Ub-Rho solution in assay buffer to make 170 mL.
Prepare 160 mL of assay buffer + 0.8% DMSO.
Prepare STOP buffer by mixing 50 mM Tris pH 8, 50 mM NaCl, 0.002% Tween-20, 5 mM DTT, and 0.2% TFA to make 140 mL.
Add 2 μL of 10 mM stock solution to each well of a 1536 well plate for compound source plates.
Dilute compounds in the source plates by adding 2 μL of 90% DMSO to each well, resulting in a final concentration of 5 mM.
Acoustically transfer 20-50 nL of each diluted compound from source plates to new 1536 well assay plates using Labcyte Echo acoustic transfer.
Add 2.5 μL of a 2x DUB solution in assay buffer to columns 1–46 on a Greiner medium binding 1536 well plate.
Dispense 2.5 μL of assay buffer to columns 47–48.
Incubate the plate at 20°C–25°C for the specified time, ranging from 30 minutes to 3 hours.
Add 2.5 μL of a 2x Ub-Rho solution in assay buffer to all wells on the plate.
Centrifuge the plates at approximately 16 x g for 5 seconds.
Prepare DUB and ubiquitin-rhodamine solutions in assay buffer for the screening process.
Add compounds from source plates to 1536 well assay plates in single concentrations or in 4 or 8-point dose-response formats.
Include DMSO only as a neutral control in columns 45–46 of the assay plate.
Add a 2x solution of DUB in assay buffer to all wells except columns 47–48, which receive only assay buffer.
Add a 2x solution of Ub-Rho to all wells on the plate.
Incubate plates to allow the DUB enzymatic reaction to occur.
Record fluorescence measurements for each plate using a fluorescence plate reader.
Prepare assay buffer, DUB, and substrate solutions for dose-response confirmation of primary screen hits.
Prepare 170 mL of a 2x DUB solution in assay buffer.
Prepare 170 mL of a 2x Ub-Rho solution in assay buffer.
Prepare 160 mL of assay buffer + 0.8% DMSO.
Prepare 140 mL of STOP buffer + 0.2% TFA.
Add compound to each well via acoustic transfer for dose-response compound source plates preparation.
Transfer 11.7 μL of 10 mM compound in 100% DMSO to top concentration wells using a Tecan Freedom EVO-2 200 Base automated pipetting robot.
Dispense 8 μL of 90% DMSO to remaining wells in the 384 well polypropylene plate.
Transfer compounds from rows with the highest concentration wells to the row directly below using a Tecan Freedom EVO-2 00 Base pipetting robot for 8-point dose response plates.
Pipette 3.7 μL from wells in row A to wells in row B, and from wells in row I to wells in row J.
Mix with 7 cycles of aspiration and dispense after each transfer.
Transfer compounds from rows with the highest concentration wells to the row directly below using a Tecan Freedom EVO-2 00 Base pipetting robot for 4-point dose response plates.
Pipette 3.7 μL from wells in row A to wells in row B, from wells in row E to wells in row F, from wells in row I to wells in row J, and from wells in row M to wells in row N.
Mix with 7 cycles of aspiration and dispense after each transfer.
Remove 3.7 μL of solution from rows H and P after the final dilution for 8-point dose response plates and dispose to waste.
Remove 3.7 μL of solution from rows D, H, L, and P after the final dilution for 4-point dose response plates and dispose to waste.
Transfer 5 μL of compound from each well of the intermediary plate to the 1536 well source plate for screening.
Stack four 384 well intermediary plates in an interleaved pattern to create each 1536 well source plate.
Transfer compounds acoustically from source plates to new 1536 well assay plates using Labcyte Echo acoustic transfer.
Prepare columns 45–46 with DMSO only as a neutral control.
Leave columns 47–48 blank for use as an active control (no DUB).
Add 2.5 μL of a 2x DUB solution in assay buffer to columns 1–46 on a Greiner medium binding 1536 well plate.
Dispense 2.5 μL of assay buffer into columns 47–48.
Optionally store plates at 20°C–25°C and up to 95% humidity.
Add 2.5 μL of a 2x Ub-Rho solution in assay buffer to all wells on the plate.
Incubate the plate at 20°C–25°C for the time required based on the specific DUB, ranging from 30 minutes to 3 hours.
Add 2.5 μL of STOP buffer to each well on the plate.
Centrifuge the plates at approximately 16 × g for 5 seconds.
Record fluorescence using a BMG PHERAStar fluorescence plate reader with excitation and emission wavelengths set at 485 nm and 535 nm, respectively.
